brief: Square one-storey frame shed about 28 ft by 28 ft under a pyramidal hipped roof of weathered cedar shingles with exposed rafter tails and a small brick flue chimney at the back. Unpainted shiplap siding weathered grey, two small four-light windows per side, a pair of sliding doors on the north side, cement-block foundation and poured concrete floor. Used as the farm's shop and implement shed; brush and bare trees crowd around it.
